actions.name: listEnvelopes
actions.description: Find and list signing requests with optional filters like status, date range, or keyword.

actions.name: getEnvelope
actions.description: Look up the full details of a signing request — status, recipients, and dates — using its ID.

actions.name: getDocument
actions.description: Download a document (or all documents) from a signing request as a file.

actions.name: createAndSendEnvelope
actions.description: Upload a document and send it to one or more people to sign via DocuSign.

actions.name: updateEnvelope
actions.description: Send a draft, cancel, resend reminders, or edit the subject line on a signing request.

actions.name: listTemplates
actions.description: Search for reusable signing templates by name.

actions.name: findEnvelopeRecipients
actions.displayName: Get People on a Signing Request
actions.description: Get the full list of people on a signing request — signers, viewers, and anyone copied.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: envelopeCreated
triggers.description: Triggers when a new signing request (envelope) is created in DocuSign — whether sent immediately or saved as a draft.

triggers.name: envelopeSent
triggers.description: Triggers when a signing request is emailed out to recipients for the first time.

triggers.name: envelopeDelivered
triggers.description: Triggers when every recipient has opened and viewed the signing request at least once.

triggers.name: envelopeCompleted
triggers.description: Triggers when everyone has completed their signature and the document is fully signed.

triggers.name: envelopeDeclined
triggers.description: Triggers when a recipient refuses to sign, stopping the signing process.

triggers.name: envelopeVoided
triggers.description: Triggers when the sender cancels an in-progress signing request before everyone has signed.

triggers.name: recipientSent
triggers.description: Triggers when DocuSign sends the signing email to a specific person.

triggers.name: recipientDelivered
triggers.description: Triggers when a specific person opens and views the signing request.

triggers.name: recipientCompleted
triggers.description: Triggers when a specific person completes their signature on the document.

triggers.name: recipientDeclined
triggers.description: Triggers when a specific person refuses to sign the document.

triggers.name: recipientAuthenticationFailed
triggers.description: Triggers when a recipient fails the identity verification step before signing.
